one_sentence: DeathVocab is trying to earn the right to become a governed, plural, searchable memory of how dying, death, care, language, body-handling, ritual, institution, and aftermath are witnessed in real rooms.
telos: Make dying more legible without domesticating it; make witnesses less alone without falsely reassuring them; preserve oral bedside knowledge without extracting or flattening it; build public usefulness only after provenance, consent, review, and cultural authority have been earned.
why_this_must_exist: The knowledge is widely held but locally oral, fragmented by role, aging out of professions, and seldom written in the sensory language families actually search for.

Existing medical, legal, spiritual, logistics, and memoir surfaces each preserve a slice, but no one slice gives the bedside crosswalk between what is seen, what it is called, who can know, and what remains uncertain.
Everyone eventually becomes a reader: as dying person, witness, caregiver, practitioner, mourner, bystander, or someone asked to make decisions under shock.

nested_teloi.aim: Build the ethical, evidentiary, source, consent, and re-entry machinery before claiming public authority.
nested_teloi.success_shape: Future operators can tell what exists, what is quarantined, what is hard law, what is provisional, and what questions remain alive.

nested_teloi.aim: Grow thousands of source-bound witnessed-moment records across phase, trajectory, setting, perspective, tradition, and aftermath.
nested_teloi.success_shape: Patterns become visible without erasing one-off specificity, contradiction, or source limits.

nested_teloi.aim: Render different views for panicked family readers, new practitioners, tradition/community readers, researchers, educators, writers, and people facing their own death.
nested_teloi.success_shape: A reader finds the record that fits their scene and leaves more oriented, not more directed, diagnosed, titillated, or spiritually overruled.

nested_teloi.aim: Maintain correction, withdrawal, cultural refusal, review deltas, multilingual expansion, and community governance long after first publication.
nested_teloi.success_shape: The archive can be changed by those it records and can admit its own insufficiency without collapsing.

what_we_are_trying_to_earn: the right to be trusted by a bereaved person in the first week after death
the right to ask living practitioners for oral craft knowledge
the right to receive family testimony without making private pain into content
the right to include traditions only where permission and community authority allow
the right to say a pattern is recurring without turning it into prediction
the right to build practitioner learning surfaces without replacing clinical training
the right to include unpretty, political, institutional, and unwitnessed deaths without spectacle
the right to remain useful when the archive says: we do not know, we cannot say, this varies, or this is not ours to reveal
bedside_record_definition: The bedside record is the situated account of what was observed, said, done, sensed, withheld, misunderstood, handled, institutionalized, ritualized, remembered, or grieved around dying and death, with source, role, uncertainty, permission, and nonclaim preserved.
not_primary_things: not primarily a glossary, though glossary handles matter
not a symptom checker, though signs are documented
not a hospice manual, though practice craft matters
not a grief therapy program, though grief grammar matters
not a spiritual authority, though traditions and experiences matter
not a legal/funeral/benefits guide, though administrative language matters
not a spectacle archive, though ugly and political deaths must not be excluded
reader_promises_to_earn: You are not the only person who has seen something like this.
The archive will distinguish observation from interpretation.
The archive will tell you when it cannot safely or honestly generalize.
The archive will not pretend that peaceful hospice deaths are the whole of dying.
The archive will not treat your culture, family, body, workplace, or grief as raw material without boundaries.

current_foundation_state.current_revision_role: mile-high clarification and re-entry strengthening; no record volume added
